evidence.title: Demand forecasting for a grocery chain
evidence.snippet:
# Demand forecasting for a grocery chain

**Client:** a e-commerce company (synthetic).

## Problem
The client needed predicting next quarter's numbers and had no in-house capacity.

## What I did
I built the solution with Time series, pandas, XGBoost. The work also involved scripting and automation.

## Result
The project reduced forecast error (MAPE) from 22% to 13%.

# Course recommendation model

**Client:** a education company (synthetic).

## Problem
The client needed classical machine learning models and had no in-house capacity.

## What I did
I built the solution with sklearn, pandas, forecasting. The work also involved scripting and automation.

## Result
The project increased course enrolment clicks by 12%.
